Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent 2.5D game creature sprite atlas, NOT concept art. Create a wide 5-column by 2-row atlas, exactly TEN separate complete full-body creatures in row-major order, one creature wholly inside each equal grid cell, approximately 2560x1024 wide canvas. Completely TRANSPARENT alpha background between and behind all creatures. No floor, no scene, no UI, no labels, no typography, no border. These bodies will actually replace dull brown enemies in a bright painted fantasy salvage game. Match the provided conversation reference's elegant illustrated creatures: hand-painted vibrant enamel armor, warm brass joints, crisp deep plum outlines, pale warm highlights, subtle brush texture, confident readable chunky silhouettes; attractive detailed 2.5D elevated three-quarter perspective, looking down at 35 degrees with top/front/right surfaces visible. Every creature faces screen-right/lower-right and is grounded at bottom center of its cell. Strong coherent daylight from upper left; self-shading on the body ONLY, no cast floor shadow. Keep all extremities, weapons, antennae fully within their cell, with at least 10% transparent padding on every side. Mature adventure enemies, formidable but not horror, not mascot, not pixel art, not brown monochrome.
Row 1 left-to-right: (1 M01) coral-red and amber enamel hunched triangular mining automaton, inverted miner's lantern helmet/head with a cyan lens, one long pickaxe arm and opposite short clamp hand, thick mechanical boots; this is the main melee enemy. (2 M02) tall narrow indigo-blue piston hammer machine standing on two broad caterpillar treads, vertical stamping hammer column and brass pistons. (3 M03) elegant teal-and-cream narrow slit-lantern gunner, single-foot triangular support tripod with a very long needle gun, slim triangular silhouette. (4 M04) small crimson organic-metal nail-bellied parasite beetle, upturned nail-shaped abdomen, six thin brass legs, comma-shaped silhouette, bright turquoise eye. (5 M05) violet/coral rolling transport beast formed by twin toothed iron wheels each with a visibly missing tooth and soft golden drive belt between, copper hub.
Row 2 left-to-right: (6 M06) pale sage and turquoise welding automaton, funnel welding face mask, long brass welding arm, large folded shade plate on its back, squared upper body, small warm welding lens. (7 M07) slender mint-and-gold cable dragging crane creature, tall narrow crane arm joined to a round cable spool, hooked claw hangs near feet, open silhouette. (8 M08) strong royal blue shield carrier, two short mechanical legs and massive cream/coral riveted shield taller than body with distinctive missing top corner and visible golden bolts. (9 M09) amber-gold and pale turquoise bell scavenger, a walking bell cage on fine articulated legs, small magnet claw dangling below, luminous small blue lenses. (10 BO01) the imposing furnace-overseer boss, broad shoulder mining titan, three small vivid copper furnaces on its back, one giant casting hammer arm and other molten-ladle scoop arm, coral and cream enamel shell, gold/brass mechanisms and controlled orange furnace core, heavy substantial feet. Boss should look large and weighty but still fit its own same-sized cell without cropping. Precisely preserve all TEN distinct species silhouettes rather than ten generic robots. Do not add glow puddles or floor markings.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: FINAL production transparent creature sprite atlas for bright fantasy action game. Exactly ten SEPARATE FULL BODY INSECTS of one coherent race called Radiant Sand Brood / 辉砂虫族, 5 columns x 2 rows, row-major order, one entire creature in each equal square cell of a very wide 2560x1024 transparent-alpha canvas. Each creature fills only 65–70% of its own cell, centered on consistent bottom contact, with generous CLEAR 15% gutters on every side; no body/wing/weapon may cross any cell boundary. NO sheet text, ID labels, icons, UI, floor, pedestals, border or cast shadow. This is raw in-game sprite artwork, not a design board.
All TEN creatures including the queen are unmistakably INSECTS: natural chitin thorax/abdomen, 6 jointed legs or insect limbs, faceted eyes, segmented antennae, mandibles, carapace and/or wings. Do NOT draw robots, humanoid miners, human faces, industrial machines, cylindrical pistons or tanks. Shared race visual language: sunlit warm brass-like engraved CHITIN armor, vibrant coral/amber/turquoise/indigo shell sections, polished magical amber and turquoise cores grown inside shells, elegant curled antennae, small runic flecks, pale cream highlights. Think the reference's beautifully painted mechanical beetle reimagined as imaginative enchanted insects with gorgeous shell detail. Crisp dark-plum painted outlines, 2.5D elevated THREE-QUARTER camera seeing top/front/side, 35 degrees downward, all face lower-right/screen-right, full-color hand-painted illustration, luminous adventurous daylight, not scary horror or cute mascot, NOT brown monochrome, not monochrome blue clay.
Row1, exact left-to-right: (1 M01) coral-and-amber pickclaw insect miner, squat triangular hunched beetle thorax, lantern-shaped INSECT head with bright turquoise faceted eye under chitin hood, one LONG curved pickaxe-like mandible/claw and opposite SHORT clamp claw, stout six insect legs; never human torso/boots. (2 M02) tall indigo stag-beetle charger, enormous vertically arched pounding horn grown from thorax, stout tracked-looking segmented chitin leg pads but natural insect, narrow high silhouette. (3 M03) slender pale jade long-needle mantis sniper, long horn/proboscis aimed right, triangular three-paired fine leg stance, narrow glowing slit eye. (4 M04) small vivid scarlet parasitic nail-tail fire beetle, six brass-colored thin insect legs, raised nail-shaped abdomen, comma silhouette, turquoise eyes. (5 M05) round violet/coral pillbug roller, two overlapping toothed carapace rings and visible golden soft segmented belly, organic wheels-like curled armor but unmistakable pillbug.
Row2 exact left-to-right: (6 M06) sage and turquoise shield-wing firefly support insect, funnel-shaped insect head, long glowing antenna/proboscis, large folded squared wing shields on back, organic four-wing shape. (7 M07) slim mint dragonfly hook-larva with long arched antenna, round spiral abdomen and dangling hooked prehensile tail, elegant insect legs. (8 M08) royal-blue rhinoceros beetle defender, two giant cream/coral elytra form a tall notched shield with gold shell studs, six short sturdy insect legs, visible beetle eyes and mandibles behind shield. (9 M09) amber-gold bell-abdomen firefly scavenger, bell-shaped lacy insect wing carapace with tiny glowing turquoise abdomen, fine insect legs, magnet-shaped hooked claw hanging beneath. (10 BO01) RADIANT SAND INSECT QUEEN, regal formidable large golden/coral jewel beetle queen with huge segmented abdomen containing magical amber egg chambers, an ornate chitin crown, translucent turquoise veined wings, large hooked foreclaws and six stable insect legs. No industrial furnaces: three glowing rounded brood capsules on abdomen hint at egg chambers, purely organic magic chitin. Queen must be a clear enlarged relative of the other nine insects, visually dominant but wholly inside its own cell.
Keep all ten designs distinct, imaginative, coherent as one radiant insect clan, alpha background truly empty and clean, all anatomical structures complete and unclipped. Transparent gutters are more important than maximum creature size.

Edit this EXACT ten-insect sprite atlas for production usability ONLY. Preserve all TEN existing creature designs, species, bright hand-painted 2.5D style, color details and their exact order. It is currently too crowded and some limbs/wings at the right canvas edge are cropped. Reconstruct any cut wing/leg tip and SCALE DOWN EACH WHOLE CREATURE individually to 60% of its present height and width, then center that complete creature inside its original corresponding 5-column x 2-row grid cell. Retain equal 5 columns by 2 rows on a wide 2.5:1 canvas, exactly one complete full-body insect per cell. The ten creatures must NOT become a single collage: leave very broad EMPTY TRANSPARENT gutters, about one fifth of each cell clear on ALL four sides. Every creature including the lower-right queen must be wholly surrounded by transparent pixels with no touching canvas boundary or neighbor. Empty alpha space should cover over HALF the atlas area. Do not enlarge the characters to use the whitespace. Do not add any background, floor, contact shadow, panels, text, labels, UI or decorative particles outside bodies. Preserve clean transparent alpha. Row-major identities stay: pickclaw miner beetle, blue high-horn stag beetle, mint long-needle mantis, red nailtail parasite, violet round pillbug; shieldwing firefly, hooked dragonfly larva, shell-shield rhino beetle, bell-abdomen firefly, large-winged egg-chamber insect queen. This is a layout repair only; species and illustration identity must remain the same.
